name: Yuki-Onna
description: Powerful elemental spirit of cold and frost on Kamigawa residing in the Heart of Frost.

description_citations.text: "Yuki-Onna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu gives the Yuki-Onna plate to Godo, who cracks it at the border with Towabara and she lures soldiers to death.
timeline.quote: The Yuki-Onna starts luring soldiers to their deaths.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Myojin reveals Toshi is being manipulated; he reclaims the Yuki-Onna's power and freezes Uyo solid, killing her.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu gives Godo a tile with the imprisoned Yuki-onna to use against Konda's men.
timeline.quote: gave him a tile with the imprisoned Yuki-onna

citation.text: "Godo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Yuki-onna turns on Godo's men and Godo faces her himself.
timeline.quote: the Yuki-onna's power was too great, and she started to prey upon his men

citation.text: "Godo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa pulls the Yuki-onna back to her original reign just before she kills Godo.
timeline.quote: the Yuki-onna was pulled back to her original reign

citation.text: "Godo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses the yuki-onna to get rid of Uramon's men pursuing him.
timeline.quote: The yuki-onna was used by Toshiro Umezawa to get rid of Uramon 's men led by Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi imprisons the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and embeds part of her power in a kanji on his forehead.
timeline.quote: Toshi imprisoned the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and stole part of her power

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi gives the tile to Hidetsugu, who hands it to Godo; Godo releases the yuki-onna in Sokenzan.
timeline.quote: Godo released the yuki-onna in his territory of Sokenzan.

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Appearing as princess Michiko, the yuki-onna decimates Eiganjo troops, then turns on Godo's own men.
timeline.quote: Appearing as princess Michiko to the Eiganjo troops, she decimated the daimyo's men.

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forced by the soratami's revenge, Toshi reverses the spell, kills Uyo with her power and frees the yuki-onna to her original realm.
timeline.quote: Then, he broke the final kanji, and the yuki-onna was reinstated in her original realm again.

citation.text: "Yuki-Onna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Imprisoned snow spirit used against Konda's men who turned on Godo's men.

pages_say.description: A spirit ravaging the Sokenzan mountain borderlands, whose power Toshi reclaims.
